written: 2026-11-07 ~23:05 CT, before any result of this experiment
finding: Train machines' best experts are almost always one of 3 lag pairs (1,3), (2,5), (4,7); siblings do not share pairs beyond chance.
hypothesis: A stronger train-learned expert prior (gamma) helps short histories (few samples cannot separate the 3 true pairs from 70 spurious experts) while leaving long histories mostly unchanged.
selection: Choose gamma ONLY on the #8 registry train folds (sampled Brier, all conditions; short_history reported separately). Official validation used once, for the selected gamma only, as confirmation.
expected: short_history Brier improves with gamma up to a point; overall effect small but positive; gamma >= 8 may hurt drift (prior resists change).
decision: Worth an issue+PR only if the selected gamma improves train-fold Brier with interval excluding 0 or short_history clearly, AND official validation does not get worse.
